name: recipe-engine
description: Deterministic, verified, zero-token replay of desktop and browser workflows Claude has already done once.
long_description: Recipe Engine is a small host process on your Windows PC. Claude drives your desktop and browser through the engine's own tools while a recipe is being recorded; afterwards `replay_recipe` runs the same workflow in seconds with no model in the loop, verifying every step and refusing anything that would type a password or press Send. This extension is a thin stdio bridge to the host (http://127.0.0.1:47391/mcp); the host itself is installed once from the GitHub release.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Every saved recipe with success rate, last run, duration and status.

tools.name: record_recipe
tools.description: Start recording: every engine action from now on becomes a step.

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop and save the recipe (or say why it was not saved).

tools.name: replay_recipe
tools.description: Run a saved recipe synchronously; returns ok | failed | quarantined | refused | busy with the failed step and reason.

tools.name: recipe_stats
tools.description: Plain-English run history for a recipe.

tools.name: forget_recipe
tools.description: Delete a recipe and its history.

tools.name: schedule_recipe
tools.description: Run a recipe on a cron schedule.

tools.name: unschedule_recipe
tools.description: Remove a schedule.

tools.name: export_recipe
tools.description: Signed JSON of a recipe for another machine - no cookies, no secrets.

tools.name: import_recipe
tools.description: Import an exported recipe; safety checks run again.

tools.name: engine_status
tools.description: Version, safety self-test result, whether the desktop is busy, background-replay availability.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: JPEG of the primary display.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Left-click at screenshot coordinates.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type into the focused field (refuses passwords and password fields).

tools.name: key
tools.description: Press a key or combination.

tools.name: browser_goto
tools.description: Navigate the engine's browser tab.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: Accessibility snapshot of the current page.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click a page element by selector.

tools.name: browser_fill
tools.description: Type into a page field (refuses passwords).

tools.name: browser_read
tools.description: Read text from the page.

tools.name: browser_download
tools.description: Click a download control and save the file (bounded, size-checked).

url.title: Engine URL
url.description: Where the Recipe Engine host listens. Leave the default unless you changed --bind/--port.

host_exe.title: Host executable
host_exe.description: Path to recipe-enginew.exe, started automatically when the host is not running. Leave empty for the default install location (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\RecipeEngine).
